thread:
sara: Heads-up team 1 Jun launch: need a micro-library of benchmark assets for the product page + webinar hero. Focus: clear comparison tiles (latency vs cost vs quality) and a single schematic that visualizes request routing with fallbacks. Also need final brand sign-off before we publish.

mike: I'll run the comparison tiles. Prefer minimal data: model name, cost per 1k tokens, median latency (p50) at 512 tokens, quant recommendation, and a one-line quality note. Add small deployment pill (Hosted/Dedicated/Private).

sara: Yes. Also include an unobtrusive methodology link and a small badge that says "source: internal eval" when applicable. Export targets: compact 360x210, wide 720x210, hero 1200x600. PNG + SVG + one GIF (800x450, loop ~700ms). Figma components required.

ineza: Routing schematic: I'll make a simplified flow: client -> smart-router -> pool priority (hosted -> dedicated -> private) with fallback arrows and a tiny callout for cache/batching. Use icon set v2, no gradients, strokes 1.5px. Accessibility: color contrast >=4.5 and avoid red/green pairs alone.

eng-eli: Dev needs: each exported asset should include a hidden export-layer named "dev_meta" with data-campaign="bench-jun2026" and utm tags. Also file naming convention: rd_bench_{variant}_{size}_{locale}.{png|svg} (e.g., rd_bench_compact_360x210_en.png).

mike: Noted. I'll include a "data-attrs" frame inside components for dev. Also adding localized copy layers (en/de/fr) and a short copy placeholders file for comms.

design-bot: Uploaded Figma: https://figma.com/file/brand/bench-mini-library_v1 1 components + export presets.

sara: Brand constraints reminder: Redwood Sans headings, Inter body. Do not outline text. Charts must use linear scales and include axis labels and units. No superlatives without citation.

ineza: Timeline: first pass in 48hrs (2173540000), review day after, final exports 4 days from now. I'll schedule brand review then.

mike: Will push initial artboard tonight and attach PNG slices. Ping me for copy tweaks.

sara: Thanks everyone 680 keeping this thread as canonical for the creative deliverables.
